meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能操作 DNAnexus 云平台:用 dxpy 上传下载文件、构建部署 app、运行监控任务、编写工作流,并处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等基因组数据。
howto.when: 当你说到 DNAnexus 相关操作时触发,例如创建 app/applet、上传下载文件、运行监控任务等。

say.text: 上传 sample.fastq 到项目,然后下载结果 BAM 到本地。
say.note: 会执行 dxpy 上传和下载。

say.text: 帮我把 src/my-app.py 构建成 applet 并部署到项目。
say.note: 会调用 dx build 构建部署。

say.text: 创建 QC 加比对的两步工作流并运行。
say.note: 会编排并提交分析任务。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can operate the DNAnexus cloud platform: upload/download files with dxpy, build and deploy apps/applets, run and monitor jobs, create workflows, and work with genomics data like FASTQ/BAM/VCF.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to work with DNAnexus—e.g., creating/modifying apps or applets, transferring files, running/monitoring jobs, or writing dxpy scripts.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to the project, then download the result BAM to my local machine.
say_en.note: Will perform dxpy upload and download.

say_en.text: Build my src/my-app.py into an applet and deploy it to the project.
say_en.note: Will call dx build to build and deploy.

say_en.text: Create and run a two-step workflow: QC then alignment.
say_en.note: Will orchestrate and submit analysis jobs.
